newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Public Bank cuts base lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Public Bank cuts base lending rate.

text.p: Public Bank Bhd, Malaysia's third-biggest bank, said on Tuesday it was lowering its base lending rate (BLR) to 9.20 percent from 9.30 percent from September 4.
The cut reflected the lower overall cost of funds in line with the prevailing interest rate in the market, the bank said in a statement.
"Consequently, the effective lending rates of all loans and advances that are pegged against the BLR would be lowered by 0.10 percent per annum," it said.
